# BodyParts3D source fixture

`FJ3383.obj` is the right scaphoid element, downloaded from the official [BodyParts3D 4.0 IS-A archive, 99% polygon reduction](https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/data/bodyparts3d/LATEST/isa_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip) on 2026-09-26. ZIP CRC verified on extraction; SHA-256 is recorded in `import-config.json`. The archive's FMA23709 (scaphoid) mapping includes this right-side element. This is real reduced anatomy source geometry, not a generated approximation.
